profile.summary: The Expanded Learning Division is part of the California Department of Education, a state agency. It administers California's expanded learning programs, which offer year-round learning opportunities for students outside the regular school day. These include the Expanded Learning Opportunities Program, the After School Education and Safety Program, and the 21st Century Community Learning Centers.
